unset.description: Properties to UNSET (RouterOS `!prop`), so they no longer apply — e.g. ['dst-address'] removes the destination-address match. snake_case or kebab-case. Not for setting a value.

name.description: Current name of the scheduler entry to update

new_name.description: New name if renaming the scheduler entry

on_event.description: Updated script source or script name to run on event

interval.description: Updated run interval, e.g. '00:05:00' or '5s' (0 = run once)
